annotations.text:
Owner-first client

The existing design has 8 nav items, 6 settings tabs, four equal KPI tiles, and a settings tab that asks a cafe owner to manage API tokens, env vars and a webhook URL.

This is three destinations - Today, Do, Ask - plus a Setup you touch twice a year. Phone-first, because the owner is behind a counter, not at a desk.
One number, not four. Profit after fees is the thing no platform gives them - so it is the only large figure on the screen.
Two connection states, not five. Prices from model.py: 1,590 / 4,190 / 13,800, VAT-inclusive. All developer surface is behind one closed door.
Most owners will never open the app. 11A.3 makes LINE the primary channel, so the daily brief IS the product - and the reply box is the Ask surface.
